# SGEN · Optometry Local SEO and AEO

> SGEN handles local search for optometry practices. Two things specifically: map pack and organic position in Google, and citation inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. Pricing is a single monthly retainer, $497 at entry, nothing charged to begin, cancellable at any point.

An optometry practice earns twice from the same patient, once in the exam chair and again in the optical, and a good deal of that second sale currently leaks to online retailers. The work here covers both halves: the exam searches that fill the schedule, and the pages that bring contact lens and eyewear buyers with them. Independent single-doctor rooms through to multi-practice groups. Stripe bills monthly, nothing is charged to start, and there is nothing to sign.

## Pages
- [Optometry Local SEO and AEO](https://www.sgen.com/optometry-local-seo-aeo): the optometry landing page, covering how the work runs, what each tier costs, sample results and the full FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO · $497/month
- Local AEO · $797/month
- SEO + AEO · $1,297/month
Stripe raises the invoice monthly and the cancellation is yours to make from inside the customer portal. There is no setup charge, no onboarding item and no exit fee, and everything already built stays on the practice's own domain.

## Method
Six stages. Audit and entity mapping across 14 AI surfaces. Foundation rebuild covering MedicalClinic and Optician schema, llms.txt, structured patient questions, a Business Profile completed including services and accepted plans, and Core Web Vitals. A content engine of 8 to 24 service pages a month. A citation network spanning local press, the AOA Doctor Locator, Healthgrades, Zocdoc and the plan provider listings. Weekly visibility reporting across Google and the four assistants. Then scaling into further practices and service lines.

## Services served
Comprehensive exams and optical, contact lens fitting and supply, dry eye clinics, myopia management, specialty and scleral lenses, pediatric vision care, medical eye care including glaucoma and diabetic monitoring, LASIK and surgical co-management, low vision rehabilitation, and designer eyewear and sunglasses.

## Key answers
- How fast does it work? Local ranking movement worth noticing usually falls between day 60 and day 120. Mentions inside ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity tend to surface ahead of that, because assistants re-read their sources far more often than Google reorders its results.
- Can the retainer be stopped? Yes. Billing sits in Stripe on a monthly cycle and the cancellation is made from inside the portal. No retention call and no exit fee. Every page, post, citation and link already built stays live and belongs to the practice.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization. SEO concerns rank, meaning how far up the listings and the Maps panel a practice appears. AEO concerns whether an assistant names that practice at all when a patient asks it to find an optometrist.
- Is there a contract? None. Month to month, nothing to set up and nothing to sign.
- Is it worth it for one practice? A single practice contests a single catchment, which is exactly what map pack visibility was built to win. The competition is a few practices and one or two chains within a short drive, not a national advertiser.
